card.name: Gentle mixing instructions for prepared solutions
card.fires_on: The word "by" or "gently" right after an instruction to mix a diluted solution or vial contents, where gentle inversion is expected next. Also seen on "and" before shaking a bottle.

modes.label: Mix by gentle inversion
modes.description: "by" or "gentle" after "Mix diluted solution" or "Mix the contents of each vial" in preparation steps.
modes.example: Mix diluted solution<< by>> gentle inversion. Do not shake. Disc

modes.label: Gently invert the bag
modes.description: "gently" in an instruction to invert a bag to mix the solution.
modes.example: To mix the solution,<< gently>> invert the bag to avoid foaming.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about turning or rotating motion (rotation, rotating, swung), which fits inversion, and away from glass-related words.
card.plain: It marks the spot in preparation instructions where the text is about to say how to mix gently by turning the container over.
